text:
maya: Quick pulse — planning to push an engine shim + updated quant profile to prod tomorrow 2026-03-18 08:00 UTC. Delta = KV-cache bug fix + 8-bit quant tuning. Window ~30m. Need a smoke lead and a rollback owner. Who's available?
rob: I can own smoke. Will run perf + sanity scripts, monitor error rates and latencies. Add me to the deploy ACL. :raised_hands:
sam: I can own rollback. I already have a tested rollback tag: release/engine-2026-03-18-rollback. Rollback steps are simple `kubectl rollout undo` + reset quant profile.
li: Can you drop the smoke command and the exact metrics to watch? Also any special caveats for long-context models?
maya: Smoke commands are below — short run. Watch list after.
```
# smoke (run from ops jumpbox)
./deploy/tools/smoke_check.sh --target serving-runtime --profile quant8 --duration 120
./deploy/tools/loadgen --config smoke.yaml --rps 50 --duration 60
```
Watch: - p50/p95 latency on /v1/chat - 5xx rate (alert if >0.5%) - GPU mem usage + KV-cache miss rate - token/sec and cost per 1k tokens
maya: Roll plan: stagger traffic 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 5m observation after each step. Immediate rollback triggers: p95 > baseline * 1.4 OR 5xx > 0.5% OR token-cost delta > 12% sustained for 15m.
rob: Ack. I'll post the smoke checklist to #eng-sre and share a monitoring link. Need the quant diff/config snippet to sanity-check.
maya: Config snippet: 
```
quant_profiles:
  default:
    bits: 8
    group_size: 128
    prefer_fast_gemm: true
    kv_cache_compression: 'lz4'
```
Also bumped prefix cache TTL -> 60s to improve reuse for short queries.
ops-bot: scheduler-bot: deployment window reserved: 2026-03-18T08:00:00Z (reminder set for 15m prior).
sam: Verified rollback in staging. One caveat: long-context models need kv-cache warmup after deploy — expect p50 bump for ~10m unless we pre-warm prefixes. I'll run a warmup job for 10m post-rollout.
li: If smoke sees token-cost jump >10% we'll involve @billing-signal. Propose threshold = 12% cost delta over 15m to trigger immediate rollback unless quality improvements justify it.
maya: That threshold sounds reasonable. Final ask: who covers timezone windows? Rob covers UTC morning; Sam can cover APAC handoff around 16:00 UTC. I'll be reachable by phone if anything goes sideways.
rob: :thumbsup: prepping docs + smoke runbook. Will ping in-thread when I start checks.
maya: Thanks — will update the deploy ticket with these owners and the checklist.
rob: Noted.
